title: Rav Dimi son of Rav Huna of Damharya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Sanhedrin 29b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.29b.17) and [Menachot 81a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.81a.10), asking Ravina a question.[^1]

notes.text: Rav Dimi questions Ravina in both passages. The place is spelled מדמהריא in Sanhedrin and מדמהוריא in Menachot.
